parameters.content:
## WF08 Responsibility
Observes persisted operational state, evaluates sales SLA, records deterministic escalation, and returns a reviewer-facing snapshot. It performs no general lead processing.

## SLA Rule
Eligible leads are qualified, processing, assigned, and awaiting sales_follow_up. Elapsed time of at least 30 minutes is breached. Nurture, VIP approval, manual review, completed, won, lost, and closed states are excluded.

## SLA Clock
SLA starts at the latest sales_assigned, crm_synced, or qualification_completed event associated with the assigned sales path. Missing audit time remains monitoring_data_incomplete; no timestamp is fabricated.

## Escalation Behavior
A breach keeps the owner and CRM stage, keeps processing status, changes priority to critical, and changes next_action to sla_escalation. Automatic reassignment is delegated to WF04.

## SLA Idempotency
The escalation UPDATE requires current sales_follow_up state and no prior sla_breached event. Reruns return already_escalated and never add duplicate breach events.

## Operational Metrics
Summary counts come from leads, dead_letter_queue, lead_events, bookings, and followups: totals, classifications, failures, duplicates, SLA breaches, bookings, wins, and active follow-ups.

## Audit Strategy
Only significant sla_breached events are persisted. Healthy polling produces output but no periodic audit spam. Null lead IDs are not relevant because candidates originate from leads.

## WF07 Boundary
WF08 does not implement recovery or a second DLQ system. WF07 remains responsible for centralized error recovery.

## Known Limitations
SLA start uses audit timestamps because leads has no assigned_at. Reassignment stays in WF04. Output is structured JSON rather than a dashboard; production could export metrics to Grafana, Datadog, or Looker. SLA breach deduplication is lead-level in this assessment implementation. A production system with multiple independent sales cycles should use an SLA-cycle or assignment-specific idempotency key.

## Test Scope
Supports future T33 within-threshold, T34 one-time breach escalation, and T35 persisted metric/audit correctness without test-specific branches.

WITH candidates AS (
 SELECT l.id lead_id,l.name,l.final_status,l.crm_stage,l.next_action,l.processing_status,
 l.assigned_sales_rep_id,l.priority,
 clock.sla_started_at,
 CASE WHEN clock.sla_started_at IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE floor(extract(epoch from(now()-clock.sla_started_at))/60)::integer END minutes_since_sla_start
 FROM leads l
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.created_at sla_started_at FROM lead_events e
  WHERE e.lead_id=l.id AND e.event_type IN('sales_assigned','crm_synced','qualification_completed')
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC,CASE e.event_type WHEN 'sales_assigned' THEN 1 WHEN 'crm_synced' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1
 ) clock ON true
 WHERE l.final_status='qualified' AND l.processing_status='processing'
 AND l.assigned_sales_rep_id IS NOT NULL AND l.next_action='sales_follow_up'
 ORDER BY clock.sla_started_at NULLS LAST,l.id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('candidates',coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(candidates)),'[]'::jsonb),'loaded_at',now()) context FROM candidates;

WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb c),
eligible AS(
 SELECT l.* FROM leads l,i WHERE l.id=(i.c->>'lead_id')::uuid
 AND l.final_status='qualified' AND l.processing_status='processing'
 AND l.assigned_sales_rep_id IS NOT NULL AND l.next_action='sales_follow_up'
),
updated AS(
 UPDATE leads l SET priority='critical',next_action='sla_escalation',updated_at=now()
 FROM i,eligible e WHERE l.id=e.id
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lead_events x WHERE x.lead_id=l.id AND x.event_type='sla_breached')
 RETURNING l.id,e.assigned_sales_rep_id,e.next_action previous_next_action
),
audit AS(
 INSERT INTO lead_events(lead_id,event_type,workflow_name,execution_id,payload)
 SELECT u.id,'sla_breached','WF08_monitoring_sla',$2,
 jsonb_build_object('lead_id',u.id,'assigned_sales_rep_id',u.assigned_sales_rep_id,
 'threshold_minutes',30,'elapsed_minutes',(i.c#>>'{sla,elapsed_minutes}')::integer,
 'previous_next_action',u.previous_next_action,'new_next_action','sla_escalation',
 'priority','critical','sla_started_at',i.c#>>'{sla,sla_started_at}','detected_at',now())
 FROM updated u CROSS JOIN i RETURNING id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('evaluation',i.c,'sla_action',
 CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM updated) THEN 'escalated' ELSE 'already_escalated' END) context FROM i;

WITH i AS(SELECT $1::jsonb c)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'evaluation',i.c,
 'summary',jsonb_build_object(
  'total_leads',(SELECT count(*) FROM leads),
  'qualified_leads',(SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE final_status='qualified'),
  'nurture_leads',(SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE final_status='nurture'),
  'manual_review_leads',(SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE final_status='manual_review' OR processing_status='manual_review'),
  'failed_dlq_items',(SELECT count(*) FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE status='failed'),
  'pending_dlq_items',(SELECT count(*) FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE status='pending'),
  'resolved_dlq_items',(SELECT count(*) FROM dead_letter_queue WHERE status='resolved'),
  'duplicates',(SELECT count(DISTINCT lead_id) FROM lead_events WHERE event_type IN('duplicate_detected','duplicate_merged')),
  'sla_breached_leads',(SELECT count(DISTINCT lead_id) FROM lead_events WHERE event_type='sla_breached'),
  'booked_leads',(SELECT count(DISTINCT lead_id) FROM bookings WHERE status NOT IN('cancelled','failed')),
  'won_leads',(SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE crm_stage='won' OR final_status='won'),
  'active_followups',(SELECT count(*) FROM followups WHERE status IN('scheduled','processing'))
 )) context FROM i;
